facts.fact: 闪回至 ten years earlier 的五月：挚友 Maggie 电话报喜，她的作品入围 spring showcase 决选，且是唯一入选的 freshman（大一新生）。
facts.anchor: “Yup! I just wanted to tell you that I became a finalist in the spring showcase!”

facts.fact: Maggie 邀女主毕业后搬去同住、随便找咖啡店打工，说受够了两人在 fifty miles 两地分离。
facts.anchor: I’m just sick of being fifty miles away from each other.

facts.fact: 女主答：对继母 Eloise 而言，逃得再远都不够远。
facts.anchor: Nowhere is far enough away from Eloise.

facts.fact: 女主与 Sean 高二（sophomore year）化学课按座位相邻相识：当时他正与她一位朋友（fifteen-year-old 时的约会）交往，那人转述 Sean 说她 cute, but dumb。
facts.anchor: I met Sean in chemistry class our sophomore year when our seats were assigned next to each another.

facts.fact: 女主与 Rosie 的 four years 友谊因此濒断：Rosie 曾和女主暗自喜欢的 Sean 约会、后来又甩了他，两人如今只靠一线维系。
facts.anchor: four years of friendship tends to break off a bit when one of the friends starts dating the guy the other one likes.

facts.fact: 转折点：Sean 吐露自己已参军，八月底（the end of August）将动身去 Texas，还说只要她愿意想把整个夏天都陪她度过。
facts.anchor: “Did I tell you I enlisted in the army?” He tilts his brows uncertainly.

facts.fact: 女主向挚友 Maggie 摊牌：参军的人一去就是多年，她一到 eighteen 岁、攒够钱就离开这个家绝不回头，所以不打算和 Sean 恋爱。
facts.anchor: Once I’m eighteen and have some money in my savings, I’m out of here and I’m not looking back.

facts.fact: 章末：Sean 见她自认悲观改不掉，承诺到夏天结束时会让她换一种眼光看待生活。
facts.anchor: By the end of the summer, you’ll look at life through a different lens. I promise.”
